outputs.explanation: Panel A consists only of fluorescence micrographs (GFP, DsRed, MitoTracker, Merge); it contains no quantitative plot.
The bottom of panel B shows two bar charts (JC-1 relative intensity and anti-HMGB1 intensity) plotting group means with error bars (n=20), but no individual data points are overlaid on the bars.
Panel C is a Western blot image, not a quantitative plot.
The bar charts of SDH and COX signal intensity show group means with error bars and sample sizes noted inside the bars, but individual data points for each animal/section are not shown.
Panel E shows FACS fluorescence-intensity histograms (distribution/line plots), a plot type that is exempt from the individual-data-points requirement since overlaying points would be unreadable.
